notes.semetey-1-2013:p1418:b003:l008: The printed asterisk marks Сайыпкуруш. It appears as a personal name or heroic epithet associated with Manas and is retained as Sayypkurush.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1418:b003:l010: Алты курч is rendered literally as 'six-edged'; the precise legendary construction of the heavenly blade is uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1418:b004:l006: Боз кисе is Manas’s inherited gray belt or belt-pouch; 'kise' is retained because the exact equipment form is uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1418:b004:l016: Both окчонтой and саадак carry printed asterisks. They denote an ammunition or arrow pouch and a quiver, but their exact distinction within the equipment set is uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1418:b004:l019: Каарданып аянып describes Semetey gathering or bracing himself in anger; the precise force of аянып is uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1418:b004:l021: Akkelte is the inherited firearm or weapon upon which Semetey leans; the proper name is retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1418:b004:l025: Козголо турган дагы эмес presents the armed hero as still unmoving or not readily moved; its relation to the preceding purpose clause is syntactically compressed.
